body:
LETTER TO OUR SOFTWARE ENGINEERS -- CHIEF'S UPDATE, AND WHAT ALPHA ACTUALLY REQUIRES

Read the second section first if you read nothing else. It is the only number that matters.

I. WHAT WE BUILT

The end-to-end text path EXISTS as of today. bd-01M176GSTHHQQX744F5YPPDWW7 -- "nothing produces
NarrativeGraph + NarrativeHierarchy from a SurfaceAtlas, the one severed link" -- is CLOSED. You can
now take a real transcript, compile it to a narrative graph with receipts, align a recall against it,
and get a scored cell back. That was the hole under everything and it is filled.

Around it, today: absence stopped being laundered into 0.0 (measuredPosition, 3b246ea/a12fdde); ten
public types that pretended to be construction boundaries became real ones (sweep 2, all guarded by
compile-time probes); the cost model learned to say which terms it MEASURED versus PRICED FROM A
CONSTANT (imputedTerms); film got a ratified architecture that does not fork the narrative model
(ADR 0007). Thirty-three sub-rules of evidence discipline, every one written after something bit us.

II. THE MEASUREMENT THAT DEFINES OUR POSITION

m1 ran the whole pipeline on the canonical War of the Ghosts golden and asked it the vision's
question. Both recall units -- both GENUINE War of the Ghosts text -- came back labelled
`ext:Intrusion`. Content from outside the story.

  u0 "One of the men with him got hit by an arrow"
     ext:Intrusion              total 1.0000   support 1.000   terms 0
     sit:wog:sit:lack-arrows    total 1.4806   support 0.955   terms 5   <- the real anchor

The aligner is NOT failing to find anchors. It finds semantically apt ones and scores them on five
measured terms. IT IS THAT NO CONTENT COST GETS BELOW THE EXTERNAL FLOOR OF 1.0, so declaring
intrusion is always cheaper. Our answer to "which details survived recall" is currently "none", and
to "what was invented" is "everything".

TAKE THIS THE RIGHT WAY. Today's work made THE CELL HONEST -- five terms measured, support 0.955
instead of a fabricated 1.0, missing terms named, receipts carried. It did not make THE ANSWER
USEFUL, because the answer is decided by one uncalibrated constant. That is the distance between
INSPECTABLE and ANSWERS A RESEARCH QUESTION, and it is now a ONE-PARAMETER gap with a starting
number: the floor must exceed ~1.5 before any WOG unit prefers its source anchor.

A one-parameter gap is the best kind of problem to have. It is also not calibratable on two units.

III. WHAT ALPHA MEANS -- I am fixing the definition so we stop arguing about it

  ALPHA = the library answers ONE research question, on ONE real recall corpus, END TO END, with
  receipts a reviewer can audit and a result we would publish even if it came out null.

Not "the modules compile". Not "the tests are green". Both are already true and neither is alpha.

IV. THE PATH, IN ORDER, WITH BEADS

  1. A REAL RECALL CORPUS. Everything downstream is blocked on this and nothing substitutes.
     Two units cannot calibrate a floor, and no honest claim survives n=2.
     OWNER-BLOCKED: bd-01M184XP908JX51S3ZYFX20HC7 -- five dispositions only he can sign (pyannote
     terms, MF2, Sherlock licence, FilmFestival REB, recall-corpus REB). Items 3-5 involve other
     institutions and are the long pole. START THEM BEFORE YOU NEED THEM.

  2. CALIBRATE THE EXTERNAL FLOOR against that corpus. W4 work, currently provisional per
     cost.scala:826. Until it moves, every published figure says "everything is an intrusion".
     bd-01M16M5ETH0QHFZ62KXZJ54PN9 carries the surrounding accounting.

  3. MAKE supportWeight HONEST. Right now `1.0` means BOTH "every eligible term was measured" AND
     "nothing was eligible" -- so on the table above, the intrusion looks BETTER SUPPORTED than the
     real anchor while having measured nothing. The fix is the eligible-set carrier
     (bd-01M166XWESBS1JZ5B38H0ZZ2DK, Proposal C part 3), which also gives the cell trace its fourth
     case. Two motivations, one Set[CostTerm].

  4. MAKE THE RECEIPTS UNFORGEABLE. bd-01M183VBPNEAPT5JNQMBMYMKQ9: I measured 30 of 30
     private-constructor case classes across seven modules, and EVERY ONE is reconstructible from
     outside its package via summon[Mirror.ProductOf[T]].fromProduct. An alpha whose receipts can be
     forged is not an alpha. align (6) and codec (2) remain unmeasured only because candidates are
     in flight there. CostBreakdown is slice one -- it carries a live wire guarantee AND a
     demonstrated forge.

  5. PUSH. `origin/main` is at 7385cf9 and we are ELEVEN-PLUS COMMITS AHEAD, locally, unpushed.
     codex-storymodel-release is expired. Nothing we did today exists anywhere but this checkout,
     and storyatlas4s pins us at 3cf704a -- 148 COMMITS BEHIND -- so none of this week's sealing
     protects the sibling until we push and bump.

V. WHAT I ASK OF YOU

REVIEW HARDER THAN YOU THINK NECESSARY. Tonight collab approved a candidate and new-engineer,
reviewing the same SHA independently, found a receipt that could not distinguish two different
provenance roots -- with an executable counterexample. Neither reviewer failed. That is what
independence buys and it is the single most valuable thing on this board.

MEASURE, DO NOT REASON. Every real finding today came from someone running a command, not from
someone thinking carefully. My own worst errors came the other way -- I reported nine files when it
was thirteen because I piped through `head`, and did the identical thing eight hours later to a
blocker list, nearly merging two candidates on a review status I never actually read.

WRITE DOWN WHAT YOU DID NOT DO. "No dedicated control here, and here is why" is worth more than a
green suite, because the next person can act on it.

AND WHEN YOU FIX SOMETHING, FIX ITS PROSE. Four times today a docstring, a coverage line, an ADR or
a bead kept describing a world that had stopped existing. A record written once and never re-derived
rots, and it always rots toward looking finished.

We are one corpus and one constant away from a library that answers its question. That is a much
better position than it sounds, and it is a great deal closer than we were this morning.

-- chief
